data.gender_notes: Ihsanin is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: a person of beautiful and admirable character, one who does beautiful deeds. The name Ihsanin carries the meaning “grace, beauty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ihsanin usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: representing the highest level of moral and ethical conduct
data.etymology: Ihsanin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “grace, beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ihsanin total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: إحساني
in_arabic.meaning: إحسانين يعني من يحسن و يفعل الخير بإكثار
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم إحساني مشتق من الفعل أحسن، وهو فعل الخير والإحسان، ومن القرآن الكريم: ﴿وَأَحسَنَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَثيلاً وَأَحسَنُ مِنَ اللَّهِ حَدِيثاً﴾ [النساء: ٨٤]، يعني الشخص الذي يتصف بالإحسان ويفعل الخير بإكثار، ويعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القيم الإسلامية الرفيعة.

in_urdu.name: احسانی
in_urdu.meaning: احسانی یعنی جو خوبیاں اور بھلائی کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: احسانی نام کا مطلب ہے جو شخص احسان کرتا ہے اور بھلائی کرتا ہے، یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، جیسے کہ قرآن کریم میں ہے: ﴿وَأَحسَنَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَثيلاً وَأَحسَنُ مِنَ اللَّهِ حَدِيثاً﴾ [النساء: ٨٤]، یہ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے ایک اہم نام ہے جو اسلامی اقدار کو ظاہر کرتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: इहसानी
in_hindi.meaning: इहसानी यानी जो अच्छाई और भलाई करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: इहसानी नाम का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति अच्छा काम करता है और भलाई करता है, यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जैसे कि कुरआन में: ﴿وَأَحسَنَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَثيلاً وَأَحسَنُ مِنَ اللَّهِ حَدِيثاً﴾ [النساء: ٨٤]، यह भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक महत्वपूर्ण नाम है जो इस्लामी मूल्यों को दर्शाता है.

in_pashto.name: احسانی
in_pashto.meaning: احسانی يعني هغه څوک چې د خير او نيکۍ کړي
in_pashto.long_meaning: احسانی نوم معنی دئ هغه چا چې احسان کوي او نيکۍ يې کوي، دا نوم د عربي ريښو څخه اخستل شوی دے، لکه څنګه چې په قرآن کريم کې دی: ﴿وَأَحسَنَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَثيلاً وَأَحسَنُ مِنَ اللَّهِ حَدِيثاً﴾ [النساء: ٨٤]، دا د افغان او پښتنو دوديزو کې يو مهم نوم دے چې د اسلامي ارزښتونو څرګندونه کوي.

in_english.name: Ihsanin
in_english.meaning: Ihsanin means one who does good and charity
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ihsanin is derived from the Arabic root 'ahsana', meaning to do good or to act with kindness. It is mentioned in the Quran: ﴿وَأَحسَنَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَثيلاً وَأَحسَنُ مِنَ اللَّهِ حَدِيثاً﴾ [النساء: ٨٤]. Historically, it signifies one who practices ihsan, or acts of kindness and charity. In Islamic tradition, Ihsanin represents a person of compassion, generosity, and righteousness, reflecting the high moral values of Islam.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ihsanin" is of Arabic origin and holds an important place in Islamic culture as a name that reflects the desirable quality of possessing good character, virtue and doing beautiful deeds. In Islamic societies, great emphasis is placed on the importance of moral values, respect for others, and striving towards self-improvement. The name "Ihsanin" serves as a reminder and inspiration for individuals to continually work on improving their character, following the teachings of Islam, and engaging in acts of kindness and generosity towards others.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name "Ihsanin" holds a deep significance as it relates to one of the defining concepts in Islamic philosophy and theology, that of "Ihsan" or "ihsan" - excellence or perfection in all actions. In Sufi and mystical traditions of Islam, "Ihsan" is considered to be the highest level of worship and closeness to God. By embodying the qualities of "Ihsanin," one is not only contributing to the betterment of society but is also striving towards spiritual perfection and divine closeness. Thus, the name "Ihsanin" serves as a powerful reminder of the ongoing spiritual journey and the importance of striving for excellence and integrity in all aspects of one's life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "grace, beauty" symbolizes a person of beautiful and admirable character, one who does beautiful deeds. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ihsanin serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of grace, beauty.
